title: Filipino-Style Menudo with Speck
description: A hearty and flavorful Filipino menudo dish made with ground pork, vegetables, and spices, served with crispy fried speck.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the menudo, onion, garlic, and tomato. Cook until the vegetables are softened.
Add the fish sauce, black pepper, and salt. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the menudo is cooking, fry the speck slices in a pan until crispy.
Serve the menudo hot, topped with crispy fried speck.
Garnish with chopped green onions and a squeeze of fresh calamansi juice, if desired.
